doc: M4-A2P-045 (env-art-b): Ch15's held dead (ch15_open_sea.md, the reveal C3), on the Ebbing's rig (EbbingMotes, game/vfx/ebbing/ebbing_motes.gd) with this zone's own data: one held field under the barge at the `shoal` mark (requested of chapters, M4-A2P-105), every mote HELD (nothing rises, no gold), drifting toward Kerrid.
_sea_note: The barge drifts bow-first (-Z, toward the dawn fog).
_water_note: The open sea's Tide water_height_y (the barge's waterline at its zone scale): held motes sink through it.

staff._note: The one attractor follows Kerrid (the rig's `staff` row names its actor): at his hands, low and weak, so the dead drift slowly up toward him from below and never quite reach.
